proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, h⟩
    have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
    have him := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp [pow_two] at hre him
    have h1 : z.im * (2 * a * z.re + b) = 0 := by linarith
    have h2 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hz
    have hb : b = -(2 * a * z.re) := by linarith
    have hc : c = a * z.re ^ 2 + a * z.im ^ 2 := by
      subst hb
      nlinarith
    have hpos : 0 < a ^ 2 * z.im ^ 2 := by positivity
    subst hb
    rw [hc]
    nlinarith
  · intro hD
    have hpos : 0 < 4 * a * c - b ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hspos := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le
    obtain ⟨s, hsdef⟩ : ∃ s : ℝ, s = Real.sqrt (4 * a * c - b ^ 2) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [← hsdef] at hspos hs
    refine ⟨⟨-b / (2 * a), s / (2 * a)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only
      exact div_ne_zero hspos.ne' (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ha)
    · apply Complex.ext
      · simp [pow_two]
        field_simp
        linear_combination -hs
      · simp [pow_two]
        field_simp
        ring
